dedupe_keys.name: a platform noise dataset of various types of subway stations during all operating hours

description: A platform noise dataset of various types of subway stations during all operating hours is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Bowen Hou et al. The subjective perceptions of passengers are linked to the noise levels in subway stations of urban rail transit systems. In this study, measurement was conducted on the noise environment on the platforms during operational hours at four distinct types of subway stations within an urban metro network. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: TXT. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 272986990336 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
